description: Wrapper-only minimization of the measured 10MB/100MB geometry-order frontier. The backend payloads are renamed to one-character files and the subprocess bootstrap is reduced while keeping clean output.

build.packaging: Minified geometry-order Python wrapper with one-character payload files.

basis: Same decoded backend, same cmix-compressed dictionary, and same geometry ordering key as the parent package; only wrapper source and asset filenames changed.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary

10m_inherited_from_parent.roundtrip_basis: Backend payload, dictionary payload, and ordered stream match the verified parent package.

100m_inherited_from_parent.roundtrip_basis: Backend payload and dictionary payload match the verified parent package; transform source is equivalent on checked prefixes.

verdict: Promote after current-driver smoke. Inherited evidence makes this the package-smaller form of the measured 100MB geometry frontier.
